_notes: E5 - Weekly minimum-wage guarantee on piece. E5 PICKER ONE works one piece job, E5 JOB, at 40 per piece, Mon + Tue 06:00-14:00, in one Mon-Tue transfer.
E5 DEPARTMENT's Minimum Wage = E5 MINIMUM WAGE (19.00) and Minimum Wage Method = Each Week are the one lever; the employer's EachDay and its empty wage are read-only gates.
Mon 3 pieces = 120 (floor 152, 32 short); Tue 4 pieces = 160 (floor 152, 8 over). Week: piece pay 280, floor 16 x 19 = 304, make-up 24 (not 32: Tuesday's surplus absorbs 8).
Contrasts: Each Day = 152 + 160 = 312; Never = 280. The 24.00 make-up folds into Monday's own card (120 + 24 = 144); there is no separate underpayment card (first green run, 2026-10-28).
The Monday is the one in days -12..-6, computed at run time. cleanup is empty by design: the flow sweeps per day itself.
